title: Katie Zacharia Makes Debut as White House Press Secretary in 14-Minute Briefing
detail: New White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia held her first briefing on October 13, 2026, lasting about 14 minutes, with questions from only three outlets (Breitbart, Daily Mail, Fox News). She said Trump would step up midterm campaign appearances and that Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle had been asked to resign. Coverage so far comes from Gray DC syndication; the Guilfoyle claim is not independently confirmed.
